blocks.html: Voice of Customer (VoC) is the systematic collection and analysis of customer feedback, insights, and expectations to guide product development, marketing strategies, and service improvements.

VoC programs help businesses better understand what customers need, value, and experience. By listening to customer feedback, companies can make smarter decisions that improve satisfaction, loyalty, and overall business performance.
A Voice of Customer program typically includes:
The goal is to turn customer feedback into meaningful improvements.
A SaaS company gathers onboarding feedback from new users and uses the insights to simplify setup steps and improve adoption.
Voice of Customer (VoC) is a customer insight strategy that helps businesses listen, learn, and improve based on real feedback.
Turn feedback into growth opportunities. MarketJoy helps businesses build VoC strategies that improve customer experience and retention.
